text: Healthy Pregnancies, Healthy Babies - See Incentives section (#Incentives:) for more info

Bariatric Benefit Coverage - For benefit coverage for bariatric surgery - Customer must engage with dedicated PHT CM if member is under JPMC account #3174696. - If member is under JPMC account #3174696, Refer to Calendar Group PHT YHF Pittsburgh JPMC (Bariatrics) for dedicated Bariatric PHT CMs – appointments are 1 hour and managed in TruCare - Under account number 3174696, When a customer has engaged the intervention (JPMC Bariatric Program) will be captured - If the customer is under account #2501770, DO NOT search for bariatric unlock call. Under account #2501770, we do not handle the bariatric case management and ONLY review for medical necessity. Approval of a bariatric procedure IS NOT contingent on completing a bariatric unlock call.
If member engages with WinFertility, benefit is $30,000 LTM. Effective 7.1.24, this amount is increased to $35,000
If member does not engage with WinFertility, benefit is $10,000 LTM
Benefit covers elective cryopreservation of oocytes, sperm, and embryos with one-year storage.
Does not require diagnosis of Infertility.
Travel Claim Payment Type: Claim Reimbursement
Travel for Caregiver: Yes, one companion

Effective 8.1.24, Case Management (except Transplant and Gene Therapy) and Customer Service will be carved out for residents of FL, GA, OK, and LA to Included Health. Please refer customers to Included Health at 833.938.9874 or warm transfer. Cigna will retain UM and YHF Coaching programs.
